scope: All eleven fresh unsuffixed 430x932 scale1.0 captures against same-named locked masters; ls05 sheet only.
method: Viewed every master and capture via view_image; checked dimensions and SHA256 pairing to raw audit JSON.
summary: All locked content, state, order and required controls agree. No clipping, overlap, missing copy, heart, on-screen Back or forbidden tab bar observed in judged surfaces. Native Flutter typography/wrapping, darker captions and shared shadows differ visibly from prototype exports; pixel parity is not claimed.
result: No actionable implementation finding in reviewed scope; exact visual differences retained below, no invented Founder acceptance.
limits: This visual review covers normal430 master views only; the other three bounded settings and additional states belong to the parent gate and are not independently visually certified here.
Behavior, native share/auth prompts, ordinary regression, hosted CI and raw full replay success are not established by screenshots.
ls05 dimmed Guardian backdrop is excluded exactly as the brief directs.
No visual restyling, source/index change, master change, threshold adjustment or test execution by reviewer.
